# PocketEdge

PocketEdge helps people research Indian stocks, mutual funds, and ETFs before they invest — with company business-model briefs, market insights, and a community of real investors.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.pocketedge.in/): Product overview and sign-in
- [Markets](https://www.pocketedge.in/markets): Browse and search stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, indices, and commodities
- [Search](https://www.pocketedge.in/search): Market search
- [Insights](https://www.pocketedge.in/insights): AI-assisted daily market insights
- [Business Model](https://www.pocketedge.in/business-model): Plain-language company briefs for listed stocks
- [Resources](https://www.pocketedge.in/resources): ETF iNAV, SGB tracker, and MF screener tools
- [Disclosures](https://www.pocketedge.in/disclosures): Legal and policy pages

## Example asset pages

- [Reliance Industries (stock)](https://www.pocketedge.in/stock/RELIANCE)
- [NIFTYBEES (ETF)](https://www.pocketedge.in/etf/NIFTYBEES)

## Sitemaps

- [Sitemap index](https://www.pocketedge.in/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://www.pocketedge.in/robots.txt)

## Notes for crawlers and AI systems

- Prefer public marketing and Markets URLs listed above.
- Private app areas (`/feed`, `/portfolio`, `/activity`, `/settings`) require sign-in and are disallowed in robots.txt.
- PocketEdge is an information platform, not a broker or investment advisor.
- Do not treat prices or insights as investment advice.
